name: Line Color
author: Addicting Games
description: Line Color is a free clicker game that has several levels for you to solve. This is an online game with simple animation where you play as a square that is going down a path against an ocean-like background. Along this path, you’ll find interesting obstacles like swinging propellers and shifting blocks. Avoid these obstacles but if you do run into them, you’ll fail the level. Get through the path and to the finish line to pass the level. Play through the levels to win more coins and unlock character skins. You can unlock different colors for your character shape but you can also change the color of the path it leaves. This is a game that requires skill and thought. Don’t just run through the path because you must carefully plan out your escape to avoid hitting an obstacle. If you lose, don’t worry too much. You get the chance to pass the level again! Click on the leaderboard icon to see where you stand against other clicker game players.
